verdict.rationale: Jan exposes a local OpenAI-compatible API server (localhost:1337, network-accessible via 0.0.0.0) explicitly positioned as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, and its docs explicitly state it can be connected to coding agents like Claude Code as well as MCP servers. This directly supports using Jan as a backend for an external coding agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a coding agent (e.g. Claude Code) actually works end-to-end against Jan's server, and more detailed setup/config documentation for that specific integration.
